description: Quoting and path handling for 'I staged too many edits...' (git reset -p)

fixture: printf 'alpha\n' > notes.txt && git add notes.txt && git commit -m A
printf 'one\n' > todo.txt && git add todo.txt && git commit -m C
commands: git reset -p release notes.txt            # unquoted: fails
git reset -p sample data                  # unquoted: fails
git commit -m 'Update notes and sample data'
git add -- 'release notes.txt' && git commit -m 'Add release notes'

checks.fact: all three edits are staged; Git quotes paths containing spaces
checks.expected:
M  notes.txt
A  "release notes.txt"
A  "sample data/rows.csv"
checks.actual:
M  notes.txt
A  "release notes.txt"
A  "sample data/rows.csv"

checks.fact: unquoted paths fail: the shell splits them and 'release'/'sample' are read as revisions
failed commands left the index untouched
checks.expected:
100644 85c30401ce288f253613cb07ee32e62128089caa 0	notes.txt
100644 626799f0f85326a8c1fc522db584e86cdfccd51f 0	release notes.txt
100644 91e7b5b17dd85f6e9b9d2d85acb2982bd5f455ee 0	sample data/rows.csv
100644 5626abf0f72e58d7a153368ba57db4c673c0e171 0	todo.txt
checks.actual:
100644 85c30401ce288f253613cb07ee32e62128089caa 0	notes.txt
100644 626799f0f85326a8c1fc522db584e86cdfccd51f 0	release notes.txt
100644 91e7b5b17dd85f6e9b9d2d85acb2982bd5f455ee 0	sample data/rows.csv

checks.fact: quoted path after -- unstages only 'release notes.txt'
'release notes.txt' is now untracked and its contents are kept
first commit holds notes.txt and 'sample data/rows.csv' with spaces preserved
main advanced C -> D -> E; topic stayed at B
'git reset -p topic' fails: topic is both a branch and a file
'git reset -p -- topic' treats it as a path and unstages the file
